name: Mississippi
agency: Mississippi Department of Wildlife, Fisheries, and Parks

rule.textEn: Anyone born after June 30, 1980 must pass an approved boater education course before operating a boat or PWC, and carry proof on board.
rule.textEs: Quien nació después del 30 de junio de 1980 debe aprobar un curso de educación náutica aprobado antes de manejar una embarcación o moto acuática, y llevar el comprobante a bordo.

minAge.note: No fixed minimum age, but a child under 12 may run a boat only with a person 21 or older on board.

card.feeNote: MDWFP teaches its six-hour classroom course free; approved online courses are run by private vendors, some paid, some free.

sources.publisher: Mississippi Department of Wildlife, Fisheries, and Parks
sources.quote: Any person born after June 30, 1980, must complete a boater education course before operating a boat in Mississippi.

sources.publisher: Mississippi Department of Wildlife, Fisheries, and Parks
sources.quote: All persons operating a boat or personal watercraft (PWC) on Mississippi’s public waterways, must have, in their possession, proof of successfully completing a boater education course while operating a boat or PWC.

sources.publisher: Mississippi Department of Wildlife, Fisheries, and Parks
sources.quote: Persons under twelve (12) years of age must be accompanied by a person twenty-one (21) years of age or older while on board the boat in order to operate the boat.

sources.publisher: Mississippi Department of Wildlife, Fisheries, and Parks
sources.quote: The Mississippi Department of Wildlife, Fisheries, and Parks (MDWFP) offers boater education courses free of charge at locations across the state

sources.publisher: Mississippi Department of Wildlife, Fisheries, and Parks
sources.quote: The fee for a duplicate card is $3.00.

sources.publisher: Mississippi Department of Wildlife, Fisheries, and Parks
sources.quote: the Mississippi Boating Basics provides an online version of their boating education course.

sources.publisher: Mississippi Department of Wildlife, Fisheries, and Parks
sources.quote: Effective July 1, 1997, any person born after June 30, 1980 must complete a Boating Safety Course to operate a boat.
The boating education certificate must be carried onboard the vessel whenever it is operated by someone required to have the certificate.
